title: Finite clopen coefficient data and derived support
statement: For an open immersion j : Y → X of schemes and a commutative coefficient ring sheaf R on the small pro-etale site of X, the published component restriction on module sheaves is additive and preserves finite limits and finite colimits. Retain the canonical finite and completed coefficient rings, restrictions, derived restrictions, rational and common-stage pullbacks, tensor data and regular coefficient units, together with the already proved support calculations used to assemble finite-clopen decomposition.

source.place: Tag 04TS, sites-lemma-mapping-property-glue (lines 5909-5926), for the sheaf equivalence; its module, derived, constructible and coefficient-stage extensions are the explicit finite-clopen argument extracted from the section-invariant well-definedness proof

proof.text: Restriction to the open component is the published clopen module restriction. Apply its exactness theorem on the localized pro-etale site; the module operations and scalar transport are unchanged. This proves additive exactness of the named restriction and its instances.

Preserve the existing definitions and proved support arguments: signed cone comparison gives the strict Roos isomorphism; constructibility and Tor properties transport across isomorphisms; localization whiskering compares the published tensor with the native K-flat tensor; normalized gluing and finite-product derived localization give the generic unbounded calculation.

Transport regular coefficient modules through the finite and completed restriction comparisons and their exact-derived single-functor comparisons. Apply rational localization and the common-stage inclusion. Cache the object formula of the uniquely specified common-stage pullback as a proved private theorem, so the final unit comparison does not unfold the chosen functor. No coefficient object, operation or existing mathematical argument is replaced.

proof_origin.place: X6, 2026-10-27: extraction of the current complete support section after profiling and improving the common-stage object-formula comparison; original public data and signatures preserved.

      PreservesFiniteColimits (clopenRestriction j R)
